usedFor: Shopify sees abandoned carts, and OneHash CRM receives the shopper when “Abandoned Checkout” runs “Create new lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create new lead” in OneHash CRM
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left an email or phone at checkout becomes a lead your sales team can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Create new lead” runs after a scheduled check.
